https://github.com/FormalizedFormalLogic/VeryWeakSubintuitionistic

I forgot to mention this here. Recently my advisor and I studied an extremely weak propositional logic (called Very Weak Subintuitionistic Logic) and put out a preprint on arXiv (See here). As part of FFL, I formalized and verified all results on this preprint.
We introduce a semantics similar to Kripke semantics (where the accessibility relation is indexed by formulas), and I think the implementation in this repository is somewhat more refined than the Kripke semantics implementation in FFL/Foundation.

FYI: @Benjamin Brast-McKie , @Thomas Waring in #CSLib > Propositional Logic
Take a look if you'd like i hope it might be a useful reference.

Note that this preprint contains a link to older code in FFL/Foundation, so please be aware of that.
